option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom, not a specific disease, and is not directly related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT).

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) are distinct from Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), although both involve vascular malformations. They are different genetic conditions.

Vascular malformation of the nose is a finding or a localized condition, not a systemic diagnosis like Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT), although epistaxis is a common manifestation of HHT.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia (HHT).
